Flash Firmware

Before You Start

  1. Hold the BOOT button on your ESP32 (sometimes labeled "0")
  2. While holding BOOT, connect the USB cable to your computer
  3. Wait for the USB "connected" sound, then release BOOT
  4. Click Start below and select your device from the list
Tip: If already connected, hold BOOT, press RST, then release both. Not sure which port? Unplug, check the list, replug — the new one is your device.

A browser popup will appear to select your device
